## Delete failed runs so they don't throw off our average
```{bash runtime_rm_failed_mpileup}
del_files=($(grep FAILED \
    /gpfs0/scratch/mvc002/scanbit/*/slurmOut/*_mpileup-*.out \
    output/snv/mouse/tempdir/slurmOut/*_mpileup-*.out \
    | perl -pe 's/:.+//' \
    | uniq))

if [ ${#del_files[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    rm -- "${del_files[@]}"
fi
```

```{bash runtime_grep_mpileup_time}
#| dependson: [runtime_rm_failed_mpileup]
grep \
    "Elapsed seconds" \
    /gpfs0/scratch/mvc002/scanbit/*/slurmOut/*_mpileup-*.out \
    output/snv/mouse/tempdir/slurmOut/*_mpileup-*.out \
    | perl -pe 's/:Elapsed seconds://' \
    | cut -f 2 -d " " \
    | numberStats.pl \
    > output/counts/mpileup_time.txt
```

I'm grepping M; here because slurm output double summaries for a couple samples
```{bash runtime_grep_mpileup_ram}
#| dependson: [runtime_rm_failed_mpileup]
grep \
    "Maximum CPU Memory" \
    /gpfs0/scratch/mvc002/scanbit/*/slurmOut/*_mpileup-*.out \
    output/snv/mouse/tempdir/slurmOut/*_mpileup-*.out \
    | grep "M;" \
    | perl -pe 's/.+Maximum CPU Memory://' \
    | perl -pe 's/M;.+//' \
    | numberStats.pl \
    > output/counts/mpileup_ram_M.txt
```
